name: Hypothetical c7i.large build stages, runtime multiplier 1.5; baseline validation host

assumptions.measured: 1089 s warm workflow, 64 GiB instance capacity, per-recipe cold timing intervals, current .deb sizes and warm ISO size
assumptions.unmeasured_allowances: 60 s discovery + 60 s start + 180 s automated desktop/installer check + 120 s publication per daily run; edit for sensitivity, not established by spike
assumptions.coverage: Foundry overlay only; current recipe catalog projected backward; all upstream snapshot commit days selected, which may exceed eventual promotion policy
assumptions.tag_dates: Include matching tags without release records, but their tag/commit dates are publication proxies, not exact release dates
assumptions.package_timings: Changed recipe cost uses observed cold interval, including dependency and fetch work; no compiler-cache savings assumed
assumptions.transfer: Gross AWS egress without shared free allowance; current ISO/deb and verified local source sizes proxy historical versions; repo-only changes reuse existing orig tarballs; metadata indexes omitted
assumptions.retention: Start empty and keep each daily ISO/changed deb for 30 days; first month ramps up; repeat longer to see steady retention
assumptions.excluded: Legacy diagnostic 300 GiB disks, retries, taxes, request charges, signing/monitoring services, site deployment and initial cold bootstrap
assumptions.powerdevil: Stay on Foundry Plasma 6.6; later 6.7/6.8 tags remain in history but are excluded from this scenario
assumptions.units: Explicit conservative decimal GB for transfer and R2; EBS GiB as provisioned. Set egress_bytes_per_gb to1073741824 to compare binary billing units; this is a planning estimate, not invoice reconciliation.
